verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway is documented as a provider-agnostic API layer that proxies LLM requests (chat/completions endpoints) with streaming support, which implies OpenAI-style compatibility, but no evidence explicitly confirms that existing OpenAI SDK code works unmodified by only swapping base URL and API key. missing for 10: explicit doc/example showing an OpenAI SDK client redirected via base_url with no code changes, and confirmation that request/response schemas exactly mirror OpenAI's format.
